在补充材料中提供了完整的建筑细节,所有模型(包括BiStepNet)的PyTorch实施可在GitHub 1 1 1 github.com/rarracy/bistepnet上查阅。

blocks.en: Similar to BiStepNet, individual footstep recordings were normalized before training by clipping pressures above the 99th percentile, rescaling to the range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and applying a natural logarithm transformation.
blocks.zh: 与BiStepNet类似,个人脚步录音在训练前通过剪接99%以上的压力,调整到范围 [0, 1] [0, 1], 并应用了自然对数的转换而实现正常.

blocks.en: IV-B 4 Left and Right Footstep Fusion
blocks.zh: 四-B 4 左右脚步融合

blocks.en:
All of the compared architectures were designed to operate on individual footsteps.
Figure 3 (d) shows the feature-level fusion strategy used to combine information from paired left and right footsteps in a stride.
Each footstep was independently processed by the same backbone, and their corresponding embeddings were concatenated and passed through a fully-connected layer to obtain a fused 256-dimensional representation.
To ensure a unified representation across sides, right footsteps were mirrored before feature extraction.
The models were trained end-to-end with the fusion head, using paired footsteps as inputs.
blocks.zh:
所有比较的建筑设计都是为了按个人的脚步运行.
图3(d)显示在步道上将相配的左脚和右脚步信息组合在一起的特征级聚变策略。
每个出行步由同一根骨干独立地处理,而它们相应的嵌入被调和并经过一个完全连接的地层来得到引信256维的表示.
为了确保各方有统一的代表权,在提取特征之前就照出正确的脚步。
这些模型与聚变头一起被训练出端到端,使用对接的脚步作为输入.

blocks.en: IV-B 5 Training Details
blocks.zh: 四-B 5 培训细节

blocks.en:
Models were trained using supervised contrastive loss ( t = 0.05 t=0.05 ) [ 21 ] and an AdamW optimizer.
An initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} was used following a 100-step linear warm-up, with a weight decay of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} .
Batches were constructed using domain-aware sampling to ensure shoe diversity at each training step, with each comprising 64 individuals × 4 shoe conditions × 2 samples, for a total batch size of 512 samples.
During training, affine augmentations were applied with a probability of 50% to simulate minor spatial misalignments.
These consisted of random rotations in the range [ − 15 ∘ , 15 ∘ ] [-15^{\circ},15^{\circ}] and translations up to 10% of the spatial dimensions along the x x and y y axes.
Validation performance was evaluated every 100 batches (treated as one epoch for scheduling purposes), computed as the area under the detection error tradeoff curve (DET-AUC) over all pairwise comparisons between validation samples.
Learning rate was reduced by a factor of 0.5 upon plateau in validation performance (patience of 1 epoch), and training was stopped early after 5 epochs without improvement.
The checkpoint with the best validation AUC was retained.
During both validation and testing inference, an exponential moving average (EMA) of model weights with a decay of 0.99 was used [ 22 ] , resulting in an effective memory window of approximately 100 training steps.
Data loaders were seeded identically across all training runs to ensure reproducibility and a fair comparison between models.
blocks.zh:
模型是通过监督对比性损失(t = 0.05 t = 0.05)[21]和一个AdamW优化器进行训练的.
最初的学习速率为1×10-3 1\times 10×3}在100步线性取暖后被使用,体重衰减为1×10−6 1\times 10×6}.
巴特切的构造使用有域-意识的取样,以确保每个训练步骤的鞋类多样性,每个步骤由64个个人×4个鞋类条件×2个样品组成,总批量大小为512个样品.
在培训期间,应用了近缘增强法,概率为50%来模拟小空间错位.
其中包括在[− 15-∘, 15-∘ [-15-^{\circ}, 15-^{\circ}]范围内的随机自转,并沿x和y轴进行可达空间维度10%的翻译.
验证性能每100个批次(为排期目的作为一个划时代处理)都得到评价,按检测误差权衡曲线(DET-AUC)下的区域计算,以对比验证样本的所有对等比较。
高原验证性能(patience of 1 epoc)的学习率被降低0.5倍,5个纪元后早期停止了培训,没有改善.
得到最佳验证的AUC检查站被保留。
在验证和测试推论期间,使用了0.99衰变的模型加权的指数移动平均值(EMA)[22],结果产生了大约100个训练步骤的有效内存窗口.
在所有培训中,数据装载员都得到同样的种子,以确保可复制和公平比较各种模式。

blocks.en:
For the BiStepNet, we additionally considered a staged training procedure in which the two streams were first trained independently before being jointly fine-tuned, in contrast to standard combined training.
The spatial and temporal encoders were pretrained using the hyperparameters described above, using the left/right fusion head from Section IV-B4 to accommodate paired steps.
Following pretraining, the fusion heads were discarded and the two encoders combined for joint fine-tuning. The backbones were frozen for the first epoch, during which only the stream-gating and left/right fusion head were trained, then the backbones were unfrozen and fine-tuned together at a halved learning rate ( 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} ) until validation performance stopped improving.
A dropout rate of 20% was applied between GRU layers and at the fully connected output layer of each stream during this fine-tuning stage.
blocks.zh:
就BiStepNet而言,我们进一步考虑了一种分阶段培训程序,即两条溪流首先经过独立培训,然后进行联合微调,与标准综合培训形成对照。
空间和时间编码器使用上述超参数进行预训,使用从第四-B4节起的左/右聚变头来容纳对接步骤.
经过预训后,将聚变头丢弃,将两个编码器合并进行联合微调. 骨干被冻结为第一个纪元,在此期间只训练出流克和左/右聚变头,再将骨干解冻并用减半的学习率(5×10-4 5\times 10×4)来细化,直到验证性能停止改善.
在GRU层之间以及在微调阶段每个流的全连接输出层中,采用了20%的辍学率。

blocks.en:
The experiments were run on a single NVIDIA RTX A4000 GPU (16 GB memory).
All three of the baseline architectures exceeded the GPU memory budget with the 512-sample batch sizes; GradCache [ 23 ] was used in these cases to enable supervised contrastive learning within the available memory.
blocks.zh:
实验在单NVIDIA RTX A4000 GPU(16GB内存)上运行.
所有三个基线架构都以512个样本批量大小超过GPU内存预算; GradCache [23] 被用到这些情况中,以便在可用的内存内实现有监督的对比性学习.

blocks.en: IV-C Part 2: Effect of Training Set Footwear Representation
blocks.zh: 第四-C部分 2:培训鞋类代表的效果

blocks.en:
Section III identified a shift direction shared across participants for a given shoe style, alongside a smaller participant-specific residual.
Building on this, we used a learning curve procedure to test whether increased footwear representation during training produces predictable gains in cross-footwear recognition performance.
blocks.zh:
第三节确定了参与者之间就特定鞋型共享的转变方向,以及一个较小的参与者特定残留。
在此基础上,我们利用学习曲线程序来测试在培训期间增加鞋类代表是否能在跨脚套识别性能方面产生可预测的收益。

blocks.en:
Using BiStepNet with the staged training procedure, we compared two training set expansion strategies, holding participant count fixed while varying how additional footwear representation was introduced.
In both cases, the baseline training set consisted of all strides from two footwear domains: barefoot, and one personal footwear style per participant.
The strategies differed only in how footwear instances beyond this baseline were added.
Single-domain expansion incrementally added instances of a shared style (standard footwear) across participants, while multi-domain expansion instead added a second, distinct personal footwear instance per participant.
blocks.zh:
我们利用BiStepNet和分阶段培训程序,比较了两个培训成套扩展战略,将参与者人数固定下来,同时改变如何增加鞋类代表。
在这两种情况下,基线培训包括两个鞋类领域的所有进展:赤脚和每个参与者一种个人鞋型。
这些战略仅在如何增加超出这一基准的鞋类方面有所不同。
单领域扩展在参与者之间逐步增加了共享风格(标准鞋类)的实例,而多领域扩展则增加了每个参与者第二个独特的个人鞋类实例。

blocks.en:
For single-domain expansion, the number of participants contributing standard shoe recordings during training was systematically increased ( k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 5 , 10 , 20 , 50 , 90 } k\in\{0,1,2,5,10,20,50,90\} , where k = 90 k=90 corresponds to the full training partition), with recordings included for a random subset of k k participants at each step.
Multi-domain expansion followed a similar procedure, by increasing the number of participants contributing training strides in a second pair of personal footwear.
For both, the random sampling procedure was repeated five times for each cross-validation fold, and performance was averaged across all folds and repetitions to produce the final learning curves.
blocks.zh:
对于单领域扩展,在培训期间贡献标准鞋谱的参与者人数有系统增加(k {{{0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 90}} k\in{0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 90} ,其中k = 90 k = 90 = 完全培训分区),其中包含每个步骤随机分集k k k 参与者的录音.
多领域扩展遵循了类似程序,增加了在第二双个人鞋中贡献培训进步的参与者人数。
对两者来说,每次交叉验证折叠都重复了5次随机抽样程序,并且对所有折叠和重复的性能进行平均值来产生最终的学习曲线.

blocks.en: IV-D Part 3: Multi-Dataset Training
blocks.zh: 第3部分:多种数据集培训

blocks.en: IV-D 1 Auxiliary Datasets
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 辅助数据集

blocks.en:
Five additional gait datasets were incorporated during training (Table I ).
Four were collected using walkways embedded with two sequential force plates to independently capture the left and right footsteps in a gait cycle, providing accurate 3D GRFs, 2D COP, and 3D orthogonal moment components during walking [ 24 , 25 , 26 , 7 ] .
The three time series of interest (vertical GRF, 2D COP) from these datasets were used for auxiliary training of the temporal encoder.
blocks.zh:
在培训期间增加了5个进度数据集(表一)。
4个是使用嵌入了两个相接力板的走道收集的,以独立地在行走周期中捕捉出左右脚步,在行走过程中提供准确的3D GRF,2D COP,和3D正交分秒组件[24,25,26,7].
这些数据集的三个时序兴趣(垂直GRF,2D COP)被用于时间编码器的辅助训练.

blocks.en:
The fifth dataset, MFID-200, consists of high-resolution 2D peak pressure maps collected from a 10 m pressure runway [ 5 ] .
Individual footsteps were segmented from the raw recordings, automatically labelled as left or right instances [ 27 ] , and grouped into overlapping pairs for auxiliary training of the spatial stream.
As MFID-200 contains only peak pressure maps, the remaining spatial input channels were approximated by using a binary pressure mask in place of mean contact area and replicating the peak pressure image across the remaining channels.
blocks.zh:
第五套数据集MFID-200由从10米高压跑道所采集的高分辨率2D峰高压力图组成 [5].
个别脚步被从原始录音中分出,自动被标记为左出或右出[27],并被组合成相重叠的对子,用于空间流的辅助训练.
由于MFID-200只包含峰值压力图,剩下的空间输入道被取而代之的是使用二进制压力口罩来取而代之的"平均接触区",并在整个所剩道复制峰值压力图像.

blocks.en:
The datasets vary in footwear coverage, some including one or multiple personal or standardized footwear conditions per user, while one is barefoot only.
Some also include additional sources of variability such as varied walking speeds, loading conditions, or cross-day collection.
All datasets were preprocessed to approximately match the resolution and format of StepUP-P150, and the same normalization procedures (described in Section IV-B1 ) were used for all datasets to improve consistency during pooled training.
Full preprocessing details are provided in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh:
数据集在鞋类覆盖范围上各有不同,有的包括每个用户一种或多种个人或标准化鞋类条件,有的则只有一只赤脚.
有些还包括其他可变来源,如行走速度、装载条件或跨日采集。
所有数据集都经过预先处理,大致符合StepUP-P150的分辨率和格式,所有数据集都采用了相同的正常化程序(见第四至B1节),以提高集合培训的一致性。
补充材料提供了全部预处理细节。

blocks.en: TABLE I: Summary of auxiliary datasets and the primary dataset (StepUP-P150) used for the experiments.
blocks.zh: 表格 I:用于实验的辅助数据集和主数据集(StepUP-P150)概要.

blocks.en: IV-D 2 Multi-Dataset Training Strategy
blocks.zh: IV-D 2 多数据集培训战略

blocks.en:
During temporal encoder training, one of the four temporal datasets was randomly selected at each step to act as the auxiliary task, with selection probability weighted by the square root of the dataset’s size.
As there was only one additional spatial dataset (MFID-200), it acted as the auxiliary task for the spatial encoder training at every step.
Batches were drawn from the auxiliary datasets using the same sampling procedure as StepUP-P150 (512 samples from 64 identities, spanning up to four footwear conditions per identity where available, with remaining samples drawn randomly when fewer conditions existed).
Each auxiliary batch was passed through the model alongside a StepUP-P150 batch, for a combined batch size of 1024.
Batch normalization was applied jointly across the combined batch, to provide a light data augmentation effect through cross-dataset statistic mixing while improving training stability.
blocks.zh:
在时间编码器训练期间,每个步骤随机选择四个时间数据集中的一个作为辅助任务,选择概率被数据集大小的平方根加权.
由于只有另外一种空间数据集(MFID-200),它成为每个步骤的空间编码器培训的辅助任务.
从辅助数据集中抽取了同StepUP-P150相同的取样程序(从64个身份中抽取了512个样本,每个身份都有多达4个鞋类条件,其余样本在条件较少时随机抽取)。
每个辅助批次均与SteppUP-P150批次并列通过该型号,组合批次尺寸为1024.
批次正常化在整个批次中共同应用,通过跨数据集统计混合提供轻度数据增强效应,同时提高培训稳定性。

blocks.en:
A within-dataset supervised contrastive loss objective was used for training, computed separately for the StepUP-P150 and auxiliary batches to avoid cross-dataset negatives, which could otherwise encourage the model to rely on dataset-specific cues rather than identity-relevant features.
Under this formulation, the auxiliary dataset is effectively treated as a second, simultaneous identification task, requiring the model to learn representations effective across both datasets concurrently.
To support convergence under this multi-task setup, we applied PCGrad [ 28 ] .
When gradients from the two tasks conflicted (i.e., had a negative cosine similarity), each gradient was projected onto the other’s normal plane to remove the conflicting components.
This improved optimization across the simultaneous objectives while reducing the influence of dataset-specific patterns on training.
blocks.zh:
在培训中使用了数据集内监督的对比性损失目标,为StepUP-P150和辅助批次分别计算,以避免跨数据集负数,否则可能鼓励模型依赖数据集特定提示而不是身份相关特征。
在这种表述下,辅助数据集被有效地视为第二个同时识别的任务,要求模型同时学习两个数据集的有效表达.
为了支持这个多任务设置下的趋同,我们应用了PCGrad [28].
当两个任务的梯度相冲突(即有负同位素相似性)时,每个梯度被投射到对方的正常平面上去除相冲突的组件.
这改善了同时期目标的优化,同时降低了数据集模式对培训的影响。

blocks.en:
For the spatial stream specifically, the StepUP-P150 loss was up-weighted by a factor of five before combining it with the MFID-200 loss because of the discrepancy between MFID-200 and StepUP-P150 input representations (due to the channel approximations described above).
All other training hyperparameters were the same as in single-dataset training (Section IV-B ).
The two encoders were trained independently with their respective auxiliary dataset(s), then jointly fine-tuned using the StepUP-P150 dataset alone to produce the final encoder.
blocks.zh:
特别是对于空间流,由于MFID-200和StepUP-P150输入表示(由于上述信道相近)之间的差异,在将其与MFID-200损失相合并之前,StepUP-P150损失被上升了5倍.
所有其他训练超参数与单一数据集训练相同(第四节B节)。
这两个编码器分别用各自的辅助数据集进行独立培训,然后仅用StepUP-P150数据集进行联合微调以产生最终编码器.

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: V-A Part 1: Spatiotemporal Architecture Comparison
blocks.zh: V-A 第1部分:空间结构比较

blocks.en: TABLE II: Identification (rank-1, %) and verification (EER, %) performance across three evaluation scenarios.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:查明(排名-1,%)和核实(EER,%)在三种评价方案下的业绩。

blocks.en:
Table II compares identification and verification performance across the three evaluation scenarios for BiStepNet and the baselines.
We report macro-averaged rank-1 accuracy (averaged across per-user estimates) and global EER (computed across all users using a single decision threshold).
Significance for both metrics was assessed using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test on paired per-user estimates across the 150 test users.
blocks.zh:
表二比较了BiStepNet和基线三个评价设想的识别和核查业绩。
我们报告宏观平均排名1的准确性(按每个用户的估计数平均)和全球环境评价(用单一决定阈值对所有用户计算)。
使用Wilcoxon的签名排名测试对150个测试用户的每个用户的配对估计进行了评估。

blocks.en:
All models performed comparably well within-domain (BF → BF), with rank-1 accuracy exceeding 93% and EER below 3.5% across the board, indicating that barefoot-to-barefoot recognition is a comparatively easy task for all architectures tested.
Performance diverged substantially once footwear was introduced at probe time.
In the BF → SF scenario, all models showed a large drop relative to within-footwear performance, but BiStepNet retained the strongest rank-1 accuracy (83.4%) and lowest EER (4.9%), outperforming the next-best baselines (3D CNN and R(2+1)D CNN) by more than four percentage points in rank-1 accuracy.
The BF → PF scenario, which introduced unseen footwear domains, proved considerably more difficult for every model, with rank-1 accuracy dropping below 50% for all baselines.
Here, while the jointly-trained BiStepNet model still led the baselines (52.3% rank-1, 12.7% EER), the staged-training variant achieved 65.2% rank-1 and 9.1% EER, a gain of roughly 13 percentage points in rank-1 over the jointly-trained counterpart.
This improvement in footwear robustness came at a small cost within-domain, where the staged-training model’s rank-1 accuracy (95.9%) was lower than the jointly-trained model’s (97.2%).
blocks.zh:
所有型号在域内都表现得相当好(BF → BF),一级精度超过93%,全方位的EER低于3.5%,表明光脚到赤脚的识别对于所有被测试的建筑来说都是比较容易的任务.
一旦在探测时引入了鞋类,性能就大相径庭。
在 BF → SF 情景中,所有型号都显示与脚内服性能相比大幅下降,但BiStepNet保留了最强的一级精度(83.4%)和最低的EER (4.9%),在一级精度上比次等基线(3D CNN和R(2+1)D CNN)高出四多个百分点.
BF-PF设想方案引入了看不见的鞋类领域,事实证明,每个模型都更加困难,所有基线的排名一准确度都低于50%。
在此,虽然联合培训的BiStepNet模式仍然主导基线(52.3%的排名-1,12.7%的EER),但分阶段培训的变体取得了65.2%的排名-1和9.1%的排名-EER,比联合培训的对应方提高了大约13个百分点。
鞋类坚固程度的这种改善在区域内付出了很小的代价,在那里,分阶段培训模型的一等精度(95.9%)低于联合培训模型(97.2%)。

blocks.en:
Per-stream evaluation indicated that the improved footwear resilience with the staged training procedure was driven primarily by the temporal stream.
While the spatial stream performed similarly under both training regimes, the individually trained temporal stream consistently outperformed its end-to-end-trained counterpart, achieving average improvements of 14 percentage points in Rank-1 accuracy and 11 percentage points in EER across the three evaluation scenarios. Analysis of the learned gated fusion weights also revealed a higher emphasis on temporal features; across all probe strides, the temporal stream received an average gating weight of 26% with combined training and 29% with independent training.
These findings suggest that staged training enabled the temporal stream to converge to a more discriminative representation, rather than allowing the fusion network to rely predominantly on the stronger, but more footwear-dependent, spatial features. The results indicate that temporal gait information plays an important role in generalization across footwear. The performance of the individual streams is examined in more detail in Section V-D .
blocks.zh:
每一流的评价表明,随着分阶段培训程序的开展,鞋类的适应力得到提高,这主要是由时间流驱动的。
虽然空间流在两种培训制度下都表现相似,但经过个别培训的时间流的表现始终超过其端到端培训的对应方,在三种评价情景中,在排名1的准确性方面平均提高了14个百分点,在EER方面平均提高了11个百分点。 对所学入门聚变分量的分析也表明,对时间特征的重视程度更高;在所有探针进展中,时间流的平均分量为26%,接受综合培训,29%接受独立培训。
这些调查结果表明,分阶段培训使时间流趋于更加具有歧视性,而不是让聚变网络主要依赖更强大但更依赖鞋类的空间特征。 结果表明,时间速度信息在跨鞋类的通俗化中发挥着重要作用。 第五至D节更详细地审查了各流的业绩。

blocks.en: V-B Part 2: Training Set Footwear Representation
blocks.zh: V-B 第2部分:培训鞋类代表

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Impact on identification (rank-1) and verification (EER) performance for the three evaluation scenarios as (a,c) the number of standard footwear instances and (b,d) the number of secondary personal footwear instances in the training set are increased.
blocks.zh: 发相. 4:对三种评价情景的鉴定(排名1)和核查(ERE)绩效的影响,因为(a,c)标准鞋类案例的数目和(b,d)培训中二级个人鞋类案例的数目有所增加。

blocks.en: Fig. 4 shows identification and verification performance across both training set expansion strategies.
blocks.zh: 图4显示两种培训扩展战略的识别和核查业绩。

blocks.en:
For single-domain expansion, BF → SF performance improved rapidly with minimal representation. As few as two standard footwear instances yielded a significant 5.2 percentage-point improvement in rank-1 accuracy ( p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ) and a 1.9 percentage-point improvement in EER ( p = 0.002 p=0.002 ) for new users wearing the same style.
Gains continued with additional representation, reaching nearly 12 percentage points in rank-1 accuracy and over 4 percentage points in EER by only k = 10 k=10 . However, the shape of the curves suggest that BF → SF performance had not fully saturated even at k = 90 k=90 , remaining more than 10% below within-domain (BF → BF) performance.
blocks.zh:
就单一领域扩展而言,BF-SF业绩迅速改善,代表人数极少。 很少有两起标准鞋类案例在一级精准度(p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001)方面有5.2个百分点的大幅提高,在EER(p=0.002 p=0.002)方面有1.9个百分点的提高,适用于同样风格的新用户。
在增加任职人数后,收益继续增加,在一级精确度方面达到近12个百分点,在EER中只达到4个百分点=10克=10. 然而,曲线的外形表明,BF → SF性能即使在克=90克=90时也没有完全饱和,仍然低于域内性能(BF → BF)的10%以上.

blocks.en:
Increasing standard footwear representation also improved performance for personal footwear styles not directly represented by the added instances.
At k = 90 k=90 , gains were observed across all personal footwear categories (Fig. 2 ), including styles visually and structurally dissimilar to the standard shoe.
The largest relative rank-1 gains occurred for hiking/trail shoes (32.9%; 14.5 percentage points) and business/dress shoes (32.5%; 12.9); the largest relative EER gains occurred for flat canvas shoes (33.6%; 2.6) and boots (30.3%; 3.2).
BF → BF performance remained stable across all values of k k , indicating that the increased footwear robustness afforded by the added samples did not negatively impact within-domain performance.
blocks.zh:
增加标准鞋类代表也改善了非直接由新增例子代表的个人鞋类的性能。
在k = 90 k = 90 时,观察到所有个人鞋类(图2)都有增益,包括与标准鞋有视觉和结构相异的样式.
相对而言,在徒步/拖鞋(32.9%;14.5%;商业/服装鞋(32.5%;12.9);在平底帆布鞋(33.6%;2.6)和靴子(30.3%;3.2)方面,相对而言,相对的EER收益最大。
BF-BF的性能在所有Kk值中都保持稳定,这表明所添加的样品所增加的鞋类坚固性并没有对域内性能产生不利影响。

blocks.en:
As anticipated, standard footwear probe performance was relatively lower under multi-domain expansion (additional personal footwear styles) than under single-domain expansion (standard footwear examples).
However, multi-domain expansion did produce comparable results for BF → BF and BF → PF evaluations.
At k = 90 k=90 , the largest relative rank-1 gains were observed for boots (27.9%; 12.8 percentage points) and sandals (27.6%; 12.3); the largest relative EER gains were observed for business/dress shoes (34.1%; 4.9) and flat canvas shoes (29.4%; 2.3).
Notably, boots, business/dress shoes, and flat canvas shoes were among the largest gainers under both scaling strategies, suggesting that the categories benefiting most from additional footwear representation were largely consistent regardless of whether that representation came from a single shared style or from diverse, participant-specific styles.
At k = 90 k=90 , there was no significant difference in personal footwear performance between the two training sets, indicating that representing footwear diversity through a single, common shoe style yielded generalization benefits comparable to representing it through varied styles.
blocks.zh:
如所预期,在多领域扩展(额外的个人鞋类风格)下,标准鞋类探测性能相对低于单一领域扩展(标准鞋类实例)下.
然而,多领域扩展确实为BF-BF和BF-PF评价带来了可比较的结果。
在k=90克=90分时,靴子(27.9%;12.8个百分点)和凉鞋(27.6%;12.3)的相对成绩最高;在商业/服装鞋(34.1%;4.9)和平帆鞋(29.4%;2.3)的相对成绩最高。
值得注意的是,靴子、商业/服装鞋和平面帆布鞋是两个缩放战略中最大的受益方之一,这表明,从更多的鞋类代表中受益最多的类别基本一致,无论这种代表是来自单一的共同风格,还是来自不同的参与者特有的风格。
在k = 90 k = 90 时,两个培训组之间的个人鞋类性能没有显著差别,这表明通过单一的,通用的鞋型代表鞋类多样性,产生了与通过不同样式代表鞋类相比的通俗化效益.

blocks.en: Neither strategy reached saturation in cross-domain personal footwear performance by k = 90 k=90 , suggesting that footwear diversity beyond what is feasible to collect from a single participant pool may be needed to fully resolve style-specific shifts; we investigated this using auxiliary datasets in Part 3.
blocks.zh: 这两项战略都没有在跨域个人鞋类性能上达到饱和克=90克=90分,这表明可能需要鞋类多样性,超出从单一参与者库收集的可行范围,才能完全解决风格上特有的变化;我们利用第三部分中的辅助数据集对此进行了调查。

blocks.en: V-C Part 3: Multi-Dataset Training
blocks.zh: 第3部分:多数据集培训

blocks.en: TABLE III: Performance improvements using multi-dataset training compared to single-dataset training.
blocks.zh: 表格 三:利用多数据集培训与单一数据集培训相比,提高绩效.

blocks.en:
Table III shows performance gains from multi-dataset training for the spatial and temporal encoders individually, and for the fused BiStepNet. Most gains came from the auxiliary temporal datasets, where significant improvements in rank-1 accuracy and EER were observed across all three evaluation scenarios.
The largest gains occurred for BF → PF, with a 3.4 percentage point improvement in rank-1 accuracy and 0.8 in EER.
Gains were observed across all shoe style categories.
Leave-one-dataset-out analysis confirmed that each auxiliary dataset contributed to the performance, with removal of any single dataset reducing rank-1 accuracy by 23–46% of the total gain.
The largest marginal contributions came from the Bialystok and Gutenberg datasets, the two datasets with the most identities by a large margin.
Notably, while Bialystok includes substantial shoe-style variation (some participants contributing up to seven styles), Gutenberg consists only of barefoot samples, pointing to factors beyond footwear-domain coverage alone as contributing to these gains.
blocks.zh:
表三显示对空间和时间编码器以及已安装的BiStepNet进行多数据集培训的绩效收益。 大部分收益来自辅助时间数据集,在所有三种评价假设中,都观察到第1级精确度和ER值的显著提高。
BF-PF收益最大,一级精确度提高3.4个百分点,EER提高0.8个百分点。
所有鞋型类别都有收获。
留一数据集分析证实,每个辅助数据集都对性能有所贡献,任何单一数据集被去除后,将排名一的精度降低总收益的23-46%.
最大的边际贡献来自于比亚利斯托克和古滕贝格数据集,这两个数据集的身份相差最大.
值得注意的是,虽然Bialystok包含大量的鞋型变异(一些参与者贡献了多达7个样式),而Gutenberg只包含赤脚样本,指出单是鞋类领域覆盖以外的因素就有助于取得这些成果。

blocks.en:
The spatial stream also benefited from multi-dataset training, but to a lesser extent. Rank-1 accuracy improved by 0.9–1.3 percentage points, and EER by 0.3–0.6 across scenarios.
The improvement was statistically significant within-domain (BF → BF: rank-1 p = 0.003 p=0.003 , EER p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ), but generally not significant across shoe conditions, aside from a weakly significant EER improvement for BF → PF ( p = 0.03 p=0.03 ).
This more limited gain may partly reflect the input mismatch between StepUP-P150 and MFID-200, as well as the specific domains represented in MFID-200. For instance, while gains were observed for business/dress shoes and casual sneakers (styles well represented across participants), auxiliary training actually reduced performance for hiking shoes and boots (styles with minimal or no representation).
blocks.zh:
空间流还受益于多数据集培训,但程度较小。 排名1的准确度提高了0.9-1.3个百分点,各种情景的EER提高了0.3-0.6个百分点。
这一改善在统计学上在域内具有重大意义(BF → BF:级别-1 p = 0.003 p = 0.003, EER p < 0.0001 p < 0.0001 ),但除BF → PF的EER改善作用微弱外(p = 0.03 p= 0.03),一般在鞋类条件方面并不显著。
这一更有限的收益可能部分反映了StepUP-P150和MFID-200之间的输入不匹配,以及MFID-200所代表的特定域. 例如,虽然在商业/服装鞋和临时运动鞋(在所有参与者中都有很好的体现)方面有所收获,但辅助培训实际上降低了徒步鞋和靴子(很少或没有体现的)的性能。

blocks.en:
Nonetheless, gains from the two streams compounded in the fused spatiotemporal network, with significant improvements across all probe scenarios.
For the hardest case, BF → PF, the fused model achieved a best rank-1 accuracy of 67.4% and EER of 8.7%, a 2.2 percentage point improvement in rank-1 accuracy and 0.4 in EER over single-dataset training.
Rank-1 gains were largest for sandals (6.0 percentage points), followed by business/dress shoes and flat canvas shoes (2.7 each).
blocks.zh:
尽管如此,两条溪流的收益在已融化的瞬间网络中更为复杂,所有探险情景都有了重大改善。
最困难的情况是BF → PF, 被保险的型号取得了67.4%的最好的一级精度,而EER为8.7%,在一级精度方面提高了2.2个百分点,在EER方面比单一数据集培训提高了0.4个百分点。
凉鞋的排名一是最大的(6.0个百分点),其次是商务/服装鞋和平帆鞋(各2.7)。

blocks.en: V-D Characterizing Model Behaviour
blocks.zh: V-D 模式行为特征

blocks.en:
Notably, while the spatial encoder outperformed the temporal encoder for well-represented domains (barefoot and standard footwear), the temporal encoder achieved better rank-1 performance for personal footwear (Table III ).
This corroborates earlier findings on the footwear resilience of temporal features, and helps explain the fused model’s approximately 70% weighting toward spatial embeddings. Spatial features are more identity-discriminative but less resilient to footwear changes, while temporal features trade some discriminative power for cross-shoe robustness.
Figure 5 illustrates this through UMAP projections of test-user embeddings from the spatial encoder, temporal encoder, and gated fusion module.
The spatial encoder produces tight within-condition clusters, but personal footwear samples are frequently displaced from the rest of an identity’s cluster, consistent with its lower cross-shoe robustness.
The temporal encoder shows softer, more overlapping cluster boundaries overall, but keeps a given identity’s samples grouped more consistently across footwear conditions.
The fused model combines these complementary properties, achieving tighter and more unified identity clustering across footwear conditions.
blocks.zh:
值得注意的是,虽然空间编码器的性能超过了代表率高的域(赤脚和标准的鞋类)的时间编码器,但时间编码器的个人鞋类的分级-1性能却更好(表三)。
这证实了先前关于时间特征的鞋类韧性的调查结果,并有助于解释被引信模型对空间嵌入的比重大约为70%。 空间特征更具有身份歧视性,但对鞋类变化的适应能力更弱,而时间特征则通过一些歧视性力量来交换跨鞋的强性。
图5通过UMAP预测空间编码器、时间编码器和闸口聚变模块的测试用户嵌入来说明这一点。
空间编码器在条件范围内产生紧凑的集群,但个人鞋样往往被从一个身份集群的其余部分所取代,这符合其较低的跨鞋强度。
时间编码器显示整体上比较软而重叠的集群边界,但保持特定身份样本在鞋类条件上更为一致。
被保险的模型结合了这些互补特性,实现了更紧凑,更统一的身份组合,跨越鞋类条件.

blocks.en: Fig. 5: UMAP of the embeddings for eight random test users, from the spatial and temporal encoders and from their fusion. Colors represent different users while marker shapes represent different footwear domains.
blocks.zh: 图5:8个随机测试用户的嵌入式UMAP,来自空间和时间编码器及其聚变. 颜色代表不同的用户,而标记形状则代表不同的鞋类域.

blocks.en:
Despite this, several challenging domain shifts could not be overcome by the proposed approach.
While 31 users achieved BF → PF rank-1 accuracy above 90%, seven fell below 25% (and three below 10%).
Fig. 6 (a) shows the probes with incorrect rank-1 matches with the largest score margins over the true identity.
Visually, peak pressure maps are difficult to match across footwear conditions. Although the top-ranked (incorrect) matches often differ from the true identity in characteristics like arch height and foot size, these features are partially obscured by footwear.
For example, one probe’s true identity differs from its rank-1 match by 2 cm in foot length (2.5 UK sizes), yet oversized boots increased the probe’s apparent foot length enough to close this gap (row 1).
Conversely, a high heel (row 2) and a sandal (row 3) produced impressions equal to or shorter than their corresponding barefoot impressions.
Fig. 6 (b) shows correctly matched probes with the largest score margins over the next-ranked identity; these tend to involve either highly distinctive gait features (e.g., a 12.5 UK shoe size in row 1) or footwear inducing minimal shift (e.g., minimalist shoes designed to mimic barefoot walking in row 2).
blocks.zh:
尽管如此,拟议的办法无法克服若干具有挑战性的领域转变。
31个用户的BF-PF排名1精度高于90%,7个低于25%(有3个低于10%)。
图6(a)显示的探测器的级别-1不正确,比真实身份的得分幅度最大。
在视觉上,峰值压力图难以在鞋类条件之间相匹配. 虽然顶级(不正确)相配在拱形高地和脚尺寸等特征上往往与真实身份不同,但这些特征被鞋类所部分模糊.
例如,一个探测器的真实身份与它的一等相差了2厘米(2.5个英国大小),然而超大小的靴子却使探测器的明显脚长能足够地拉近这一差距(一行).
相反地,高跟鞋(第2卷)和凉鞋(第3卷)产生的印象相当于或短于相应的赤脚印象.
图6(b) 显示的探测器正确匹配,比次等身份的得分幅度最大;这些探测器往往涉及高度独特的跑步特征(例如第1行有12.5个英国鞋尺寸)或鞋类诱导最小的转变(例如设计来模仿第2行赤脚行走的小脚鞋)。

blocks.en:
Fig. 7 shows recognition performance by footwear category.
Flat canvas shoes and casual sneakers, both relatively homogeneous in sole construction and well represented in StepUP-P150 and the auxiliary datasets, achieved the highest rank-1 accuracy.
The small “Other” category, consisting primarily of minimalist shoes and foam clogs (e.g., Crocs), performed comparably well.
Business/dress shoes and hiking/trail shoes were the most difficult categories, likely reflecting their greater structural variability and more pronounced gait effects.
Notably, training set representation alone did not predict performance. Athletic shoes were the most prevalent style in StepUP-P150 (as well as the ForceID-A and Bialystok auxiliary datasets), yet achieved a rank-1 accuracy nearly 20 percentage points lower than flat canvas shoes, plausibly due to the broad structural diversity within the athletic category (running shoes, trainers, basketball sneakers, etc., each with differently structured soles).
blocks.zh:
图7按鞋类显示识别性能。
平面帆布鞋和跑鞋在单体构造中相对均匀,在StepUP-P150和辅助数据集中都有很好的体现,均达到了最高的一级精度.
小型的“其他”类别主要由最小的鞋和泡沫堵塞(如克罗克)组成,表现相当好。
商业/服装鞋和徒步/拖鞋是最困难的类别,可能反映其更大的结构可变性和更明显的速度效应。
值得注意的是,单靠培训人员代表并不能预测业绩。 运动鞋是StepUP-P150(以及ForceID-A和Bialystok辅助数据集)中最流行的风格,然而由于运动类(跑鞋,教练,篮球运动鞋等,各有不同结构的鞋底)内部结构相去甚远,因此取得了与平底帆鞋相去甚远的一等精度近20个百分点.

blocks.en: Fig. 6: Peak pressure images for extreme probe cases: (a) the most confident false matches (those with the largest similarity score margin over the true identity), and (b) the most confident true matches (largest score margin over the next-ranked identity).
blocks.zh: 发相. 6: 对于极端探险案例的峰压图像:(a)最有自信的假相(那些在真实身份上具有最大相似度分差的),和(b)最有信心的真相(在下个排名身份上得分比最大).

blocks.en: Fig. 7: Identification (rank-1) and verification (EER) performance for each shoe style category.
blocks.zh: 图7:每个鞋型类别的识别(排名-1)和验证(EER)性能.

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: VI-A Implications for Footwear-Robust Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 六-A 对穿鞋-穿鞋代表学习的影响

blocks.en:
The proposed BiStepNet architecture significantly outperformed the 3D architecture baselines for cross-shoe recognition, with the largest gains for unseen personal footwear styles (more than 18 percentage points in rank-1 accuracy, 5 in EER), despite the baselines having access to the full 3D footstep volume.
We attribute this to the inductive biases of the decomposed design, with two streams to independently learn from information-dense spatial and temporal gait representations prior to fusion.
The architecture is similar in concept to two-stream approaches in both footstep recognition (two parallel ResNets to learn from peak pressure images and pressure sequences separately [ 29 ] ) and action recognition (one stream to encode RGB video frames and another to encode optical flow sequences [ 30 ] ).
blocks.zh:
拟议的BiStepNet架构大大地超过了跨鞋类识别的3D架构基线,在隐形个人鞋类风格方面收获最大(在排名1的精确度上超过18个百分点,在EER中为5个百分点),尽管基线可以访问完整的3D脚步音量.
我们将此归因于被分解的设计的诱导性偏差,在聚变前有两道溪流独立地从信息敏捷的空间和时间快慢表现中学习.
该架构在概念上与双流方法相类似,既包括脚步识别(两个平行的ResNet分别从峰值压力图像和压力序列中学习[29]),也包括动作识别(一个流用于编码RGB视频帧,另一个流用于编码光学流序列[30]).

blocks.en:
The superior performance of the bi-stream model parallels longstanding findings in fields like action recognition. Architectures that jointly model spatial and temporal structure in a single pathway often carry more parameters and have historically required much larger training sets to match decomposed approaches, only becoming competitive once large-scale datasets such as Sports-1M and Kinetics-400 became available [ 31 ] .
Given the current scale of footstep biometric datasets, architectures with stronger structural priors may remain preferable for now, while a shift toward higher-capacity architectures may become viable with additional large datasets.
This trend was already observed in a recent competition that used all 150 users from the StepUP-P150 dataset for model development [ 32 ] , where the top solutions used R(2+1)D CNNs.
blocks.zh:
双流模型的优异性能与诸如行动识别等领域内的长期发现相类似. 在一个单一路径上联合建模空间和时间结构的架构往往携带更多的参数,而且历史上需要大得多的培训组合来匹配已分解的方法,只有在Sports-1M和Kinetics-400等大型数据集获得后才变得具有竞争力[31].
鉴于目前步道生物特征数据集的规模,结构前身较强的架构目前可能仍较为可取,而随着更多大型数据集的出现,转向高容量架构可能变得可行。
这一趋势已经在最近使用StepUP-P150数据集的所有150个用户用于模型开发的比赛中观察到了. [32],其中顶端的解决方案使用了R(2+1)D CNN.

blocks.en:
Beyond providing a stronger structural prior for limited data, the decomposed architecture may also better preserve temporal information specifically.
As discussed in Section V-D , spatial features are more discriminative in isolation but less footwear-resilient than temporal features.
When the two streams were trained jointly, spatial features tended to dominate the training signal, consistent with the established phenomenon of modality competition in multi-modal learning [ 33 ] .
Because the streams are separable, this competition could be addressed directly through staged training, a common strategy in fields such as action recognition [ 30 ] , allowing the temporal stream to converge to a more discriminative, footwear-resilient representation than under joint training.
The 3D architectures, by contrast, have no analogous mechanism to protect weaker but more footwear-robust temporal cues from being overshadowed, a limitation the proposed architecture avoids by design.
blocks.zh:
除了为有限的数据提供更强大的结构前,分解结构还可以更好地具体保存时间信息。
如第五至D节所讨论,空间特征在孤立中较有区别,但比起时间特征,鞋类耐受性较低。
在联合培训两条溪流时,空间特征往往在培训信号中占主导地位,这与在多模式学习中既定的模式竞争现象是一致的[33]。
由于分流是可分流的,这一竞争可以通过分阶段培训直接解决,这是行动识别等领域的一项共同战略[30],使得分流时间与联合培训相比更加具有歧视性、耐鞋性的代表性。
相形之下,3D架构没有类似的机制来保护更弱而更活泼的时空提示不被遮蔽,这是拟议架构通过设计避免的局限性.

blocks.en: VI-B Learnability of Footwear-Induced Shift
blocks.zh: 六-B 学习由脚套引起的移动

blocks.en:
Heterogeneous class-conditional shift, in which a domain shift affects different classes in different ways, has been documented in other areas of machine learning such as computer vision.
For instance, a shift from day to night causes pedestrians to be shadowed in darkness while a streetlamp will instead become illuminated [ 34 ] .
A structurally similar problem in biometrics is cross-age face recognition, where the effects of aging can differ across individuals [ 35 ] ; however, this is generally treated as a source of variability that can be learned and generalized to new users given sufficient training representation.
We hypothesized that a similar assumption would hold for footwear-induced domain shift.
blocks.zh:
异相类条件变化,即域位变化以不同方式影响不同类,在计算机视觉等机器学习的其他领域都有记载.
例如,从白天到晚上的转变导致行人被黑暗所笼罩,而一个街道被照亮[34]。
在生物鉴别学中,一个结构上类似的问题就是跨年龄识别,在这种识别中,衰老的影响可能因个人而异[35];然而,这通常被视为一个可被了解的可变性来源,并被推广到新的用户,只要有足够的培训代表。
我们假设鞋类引起的域位转移 会有类似的假设

blocks.en:
The results for the standard footwear style provide direct evidence for the learnability and transferability of footwear-robust representations. The trained embeddings transferred well to new users overall (85.0% rank-1 accuracy), and performance scaled predictably with the number of training identities represented in that footwear style.
The rapid early gains followed by a long tail toward saturation are consistent with the shift structure identified in Section III : the dominant, shared component of the domain shift may be learnable from very few examples, while the smaller, participant-specific residual requires substantially more representation to resolve.
blocks.zh:
标准鞋类风格的结果为鞋类活性表现的可学习性和可转移性提供了直接的证据。 训练有素的嵌入器向新的用户整体转移良好(85.0%的一等精度),其性能随着这种鞋型中体现的培训身份数量而可预期地有所提升。
迅速的早期收益,然后是朝饱和方向走去的长尾巴,这与第三节确定的转移结构是一致的:从极少数的例子中可能可以了解域转移中占主导地位的共同组成部分,而较小的、针对参与者的剩余部分则需要大大提高代表性才能解决。

blocks.en:
This shift structure is also supported by the biomechanics literature.
The existence of a shared shift component aligns with prior work reporting broadly similar effects across individuals for specific footwear styles, such as high heels [ 36 ] , flip-flop sandals [ 37 ] , and running shoes of varied designs [ 38 ] .
However, the nature and magnitude of these effects can be modulated by person-specific physiology and behaviour.
Butler et al. [ 39 ] , for instance, found an interaction between arch type and shoe type during running, with low-arched and high-arched runners exhibiting different loading responses to two sole designs.
Footwear effects have also been shown to vary with factors like walking speed [ 40 , 41 ] and familiarity with a given style [ 42 ] .
Further, Horst et al. [ 43 ] identified subject-specific responses to different footwear during running.
However, footwear type itself could be classified across participants with high accuracy (median 87.8%), suggesting that footwear effects are simultaneously person-specific and systematic enough to be learned.
blocks.zh:
这种转向结构也得到生物力学文献的支持.
共有轮班部分的存在与以前的工作报告一致,个人对特定鞋型的影响大致相似,例如高跟鞋[36]、翻发式凉鞋[37]和各种设计的跑鞋[38]。
然而,这些影响的性质和程度可以由个人特有的生理学和行为来调节.
例如,Butler等人[39]在跑步时发现了拱形型和鞋型之间的相互作用,低级和高级跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跳跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑跑
脚套效应也因行走速度[40,41]和熟悉给定风格[42]等因素而异.
此外,Horst等人也指出: [43] 确定了对运行期间不同鞋类的具体主题反应。
然而,鞋类本身可以在参与者中以高精度进行分类(中位数87.8%),这表明鞋类效应同时是针对具体个人的,并且系统化,足以被学习.

blocks.en:
The shape of the learning curve, however, suggests that additional identities are still needed to fully resolve the standard footwear domain. Unlike for personal footwear styles, adding a fourth domain per training user did not improve performance for this domain ( p > 0.05 p>0.05 ). This suggests that further gains will require additional identities represented in that style (or in styles with similar characteristics), rather than additional domains from existing identities.
Consistent with this, we observed a small but significant increase in BF → SF performance when additional identities were incorporated with the auxiliary datasets (Table III ).
Even so, we cannot determine whether the saturated performance for this style would eventually match the high within-domain performance observed for BF → BF comparisons.
It is possible that part of this gap reflects shift components unique to each person that could not be learned even from a much larger training population.
This question cannot be answered based on the results of the current study.
If there is an unresolvable gap, alternative strategies beyond training set scaling, such as (automated or supervised) reference updating [ 44 ] , may be needed to close it.
blocks.zh:
然而,学习曲线的外形表明,仍然需要更多的身份才能完全解决标准鞋域. 与个人鞋类风格不同,每个培训用户增加一个第四个域没有改善这个域的性能(p > 0.05 p>0.05). 这表明,进一步收益将需要以这种风格(或具有类似特征的风格)体现的更多身份,而不是从现有身份中获得更多领域。
与此相符合,我们看到BF → SF性能略有增加,但在辅助数据集中纳入了额外身份(表三)之后,BF → SF性能有了显著提高。
即便如此,我们也无法确定这种风格的饱和性能最终是否与BF-BF比较观察到的高域内性能相匹配.
有可能,这一差距的一部分反映了每个人独特的转变部分,即使从更多的受训人员那里也学不到。
这个问题不能根据目前的研究结果来回答。
如果存在无法弥补的差距,可能需要在培训成套规模之外采取替代战略,例如(自动或监督)参考更新[44]。

blocks.en:
For the more varied personal footwear styles, although there remains substantial room for improvement, we note several promising observations.
Performance improved both with additional identities represented in existing domains (approximately 10 percentage points in rank-1 accuracy from k = 0 k=0 to k = 90 k=90 ) and with additional domains represented per identity (approximately 50% rank-1 with two domains, 60% with three, and 65% with all four).
Notably, this scaling held regardless of whether the third domain added per participant was the shared standard shoe or a distinct personal footwear style, indicating that learned features generalize across domains to at least some extent, rather than being specific to the individual style.
blocks.zh:
对于更加多样化的个人鞋类风格,尽管仍有很大的改进余地,但我们注意到若干有希望的看法。
表现有所改善,现有领域增加了身份(从k=0k=0到k=90k=90的精确度约为10个百分点),每个身份增加了身份(大约50%的级别-1有2个,60%有3个,65%有4个)。
值得注意的是,无论每个参与者增加的第三个域是共享标准鞋还是独特的个人鞋型,这种缩放都表明,所学的特征至少在某种程度上泛指各个域,而不是针对个人样式。

blocks.en:
This generalization may reflect one or both of two underlying mechanisms.
First, footwear styles may share a generic barefoot-to-shod shift component, and the model may be learning invariance to this shared component specifically.
This aligns with the average cosine similarity of 0.42 across all barefoot-to-personal-footwear shift vectors that was identified in Section III , indicating meaningful shared structure even among otherwise dissimilar styles.
Alternatively, the model may be learning robustness to specific shoe properties, such as the effects of particular heel heights or sole textures, which recur across nominally different styles.
In this case, adequate training representation may not require direct instances of every specific style, but rather sufficient combined representation of the underlying effects relevant to a style, drawn from a large and varied set of individuals (e.g., the effects of flat soles learned from one group of individuals, and of soft soles from another).
This suggests that targeted data collection could reasonably prioritize families of styles sharing relevant structural characteristics, such as popular styles or those most representative of a given deployment’s expected footwear distribution (e.g., rigid-soled, high-arch business footwear for an office building), rather than attempting to represent every anticipated style directly.
blocks.zh:
这种概括可能反映了两个基本机制中的一个或两个机制。
首先,鞋类样式可能共享一个通用的光脚到相接转向组件,而模型可能正在具体学习该共享组件的偏差.
这与第三节确定的所有赤脚至人足服转变向量的平均同位素相似度为0.42,这表明即使不同风格之间也有有意义的共同结构。
或者,该模型可能正在学习对特定鞋类特性的稳健性,例如特定鞋跟高地或唯一纹理的影响,这些纹理在名义上是不同的样式重复出现的。
在这种情况下,适当的培训代表可能不需要每一种具体风格的直接实例,而是需要充分综合地反映与一种风格有关的基本影响,这些影响取自一大群不同的个人(例如从一组个人学到的平底鞋和从另一组人学到的软底鞋)。
这表明,有针对性地收集数据可以合理优先考虑具有相关结构特征的风格家庭,如流行风格或最能代表特定部署预期鞋类分布的风格(如办公楼的僵硬、高档商业鞋类),而不是试图直接代表每一种预期风格。

blocks.en: VI-C Multi-Dataset Training
blocks.zh: VI-C 多数据集培训

blocks.en:
The unsaturated learning curves in Part 2 suggest that further gains in cross-shoe recognition require more data than any single available dataset can provide.
In the absence of a sufficiently large dataset collected under a single protocol, pooling data from multiple sources is a natural alternative.
Multi-dataset training has proven effective in other domains facing similar data constraints, including lesion detection from medical images [ 45 ] , and semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds [ 46 ] .
The decomposed architecture adopted in this work, which relies on established, lower-dimensional gait representations, allows each stream to draw on related auxiliary datasets that would be incompatible with a 3D architecture.
blocks.zh:
第二部分中的不饱和学习曲线表明,在交叉鞋类识别方面的进一步收益需要比任何单一可用数据集所能提供的数据更多的数据.
在缺乏根据单一协议收集的足够大的数据组的情况下,汇集来自多个来源的数据是一种自然的可选办法.
多数据集培训在面临类似数据限制的其他领域证明是有效的,包括从医疗图像中检测出损伤[45],以及三维点云的语义分解[46].
本作中采用的分解结构依赖于已建立,下维的"行走"表示方式,使每个流都能够取用与3D架构不相容的相关辅助数据集.

blocks.en:
However, previous studies have demonstrated the challenges associated with pooling gait datasets from different sources.
Derlatka et al. [ 47 ] found that collection location significantly affected ground reaction force measurements despite similar hardware and collection protocols.
Similarly, Fleischmann et al. [ 48 ] showed that they could predict the source of four different gait datasets with up to 99% accuracy, indicating that dataset-specific artifacts, rather than genuine gait or identity information, can dominate pooled feature representations if left unaddressed.
Duncanson et al. [ 49 ] , who evaluated combinations of four force plate datasets (including the ForceID-A, GaitRec, and Gutenberg datasets used in this work) reported mixed results on recognition performance. The benefit of the auxiliary datasets depended heavily on dataset compatibility, with many combinations resulting in poorer performance than training with the target dataset alone.
blocks.zh:
然而,以往的研究表明,汇集不同来源的行走数据集是一项挑战。
Derlatka 等 [47] 发现,尽管有类似的硬件和收集协议,收集位置仍然严重影响了地面反应力的测量.
同样地,Fleischmann等人[48]表明,他们可以预测四种不同步态数据集的来源,其精确度可达99%,表明数据集特有的文物,而不是真正的步态或身份信息,如果得不到解决,就可以主导集合特征表述。
Duncanson等[49],评价了四个力板数据集(包括本作中使用的ForceID-A,Gaitrec和Gutenberg数据集)的组合,报告了识别性能的好坏参半. 辅助数据集的好处在很大程度上取决于数据集的相容性,许多组合导致的性能不如仅对目标数据集的培训.

blocks.en:
To improve the compatibility and effectiveness of the auxiliary datasets during training, we adopted several strategies.
All samples were resized and normalized to approximately match StepUP-P150, since normalization has been shown to reduce dataset-specific bias in prior gait work [ 48 ] .
Loss was computed separately within each dataset rather than across pooled batches, to prevent the model from exploiting dataset-specific cues as a shortcut for identity discrimination.
Finally, PCGrad was used to resolve destructive gradient interference when combining loss gradients from different datasets, encouraging convergence toward a shared solution rather than one that favors either objective at the other’s expense.
Our approach framed multi-dataset training as a form of multi-task learning, in which each dataset constitutes a related task and the model is required to enforce conditional invariance simultaneously across all of them, with every training step informed by both the target and an auxiliary dataset.
blocks.zh:
为了提高辅助数据集在培训期间的相容性和有效性,我们采取了若干战略。
所有样本都进行了调整并正常化,大致与StepUP-P150相匹配,因为已显示正常化可减少在前步工作方面对数据集的偏差[48].
损失在每一数据集中单独计算,而不是在集合批次中计算,以防止该模型利用特定数据集提示作为识别歧视的捷径。
最后,PCGrad被用于在将不同数据集的损失梯度结合起来时解决破坏性梯度干扰问题,鼓励趋同于共同解决方案,而不是以牺牲对方的目标为代价。
我们的方法将多数据集培训作为多任务学习的一种形式,其中每个数据集构成一项相关任务,该模型必须同时在所有数据集中实施有条件的偏差,每个培训步骤都同时遵循目标和辅助数据集。

blocks.en:
The resulting gains were consistent but modest, likely reflecting the same compatibility limitations observed in prior pooled gait studies. Differences in sensing modality, protocol, and population between StepUP-P150 and the auxiliary datasets constrain how much identity-relevant information can transfer.
Even with the added datasets, several footwear styles with pronounced or unusual biomechanical effects, such as hiking or winter boots, remained poorly represented in training and correspondingly difficult to recognize.
Notably, however, gains were not restricted to datasets with rich footwear diversity; Gutenberg, despite consisting entirely of barefoot recordings, contributed a marginal improvement comparable to Bialystok’s, whose participants each contributed multiple footwear styles.
This suggests that at least part of the benefit of auxiliary training comes from reinforcing general, identity-related gait structure, information that helps the model discriminate individuals regardless of footwear, rather than solely from learning explicit footwear-to-footwear shifts.
blocks.zh:
其结果是一贯的,但程度不大,可能反映了在以前集合速度研究中观察到的相同的兼容性限制。 StepUP-P150和辅助数据集之间在感知方式、协议和人口方面的差异限制了与身份有关的信息的传输。
即便增加了数据集,一些具有明显或不寻常的生物机械效应的鞋类风格,如徒步旅行或冬季靴子,在培训中仍然代表不足,因此难以识别。
但值得注意的是,收益并不局限于鞋类多样性丰富的数据集;古滕贝格尽管完全由赤脚录音组成,但与比亚利斯托克相比,贡献了微小的改进,后者的参与者各自贡献了多种鞋类风格.
这表明,辅助培训的好处至少部分来自加强一般的、与身份有关的行走结构,即有助于模式歧视个人而不分鞋类的信息,而不只是学习明确的鞋类到脚服的转变。

blocks.en: VI-D Future Work
blocks.zh: VI-D 今后的工作

blocks.en:
The present study used barefoot reference strides, consistent with previous work [ 5 ] ; barefoot enrollment may be practical in some deployment contexts and provides a common reference domain across users. Moreover, learning the shift between barefoot and shod conditions may be more tractable than between arbitrary pairs of footwear styles.
Indeed, although the same performance trends were observed when personal footwear styles were used as the reference domain, recognition of other personal styles (PF1 → \rightarrow PF2 and PF2 → \rightarrow PF1) decreased by an average of 3.4 percentage points in rank-1 accuracy.
By contrast, using the standard footwear as the reference domain produced an average 7.6 percentage point improvement for personal footwear recognition (SF → \rightarrow PF).
Thus, the choice of enrollment condition can meaningfully affect cross-footwear performance and should be evaluated according to the requirements of the target application.
blocks.zh:
本研究采用了与以前的工作相符合的赤脚参考脚步;赤脚入学在某些部署情况下可能切合实际,为用户提供了一个共同的参考领域。 此外,学习赤脚和乔德条件之间的转变可能比任意的一对鞋型更能拉动.
事实上,虽然在使用个人鞋类样式作为参考领域时也观察到了同样的性能趋势,但其他个人样式(PF1 → 右翼PF2和PF2 → 右翼PF1)的识别率在一等一的准确度上平均下降了3.4个百分点.
相比之下,将标准鞋类作为参考域,平均提高了7.6个百分点,用于个人鞋类识别(SF ~\正方形PF)。
因此,入学条件的选择可有意义地影响跨脚服的性能,应根据目标应用的要求进行评估。

blocks.en:
The study also assumes five reference strides (10 footsteps, corresponding to approximately two passes across the sensing platform and 10 seconds of walking) and only one probe stride available for each transaction.
The enrollment requirement is smaller than in several previous studies, including Zhou et al. [ 5 ] (approximately 28 footsteps), Wang et al. [ 9 ] (72 footsteps), and Connor et al. [ 8 ] (24 footsteps), but larger than the single-stride enrollment assumed by Duncanson et al. [ 7 ] .
Similarly, the present two-footstep transaction provides less information than approaches that aggregate multiple consecutive strides for inference [ 8 , 5 , 9 ] .
Future work should evaluate the trade-off between enrollment effort, transaction duration, and recognition performance.
blocks.zh:
研究还假定了五个参考脚步(10个脚步,相当于大约两个穿过感知平台和10秒行走),每次交易只能有1个探测脚步.
入学要求比以前的一些研究,包括周等,都小. [5] (约28步), 王等. [9] (72脚步),和康纳等. [8] (24个脚步),但比邓肯森等所假定的单程入学人数要多. [7].
同样,目前两步交易提供的信息也少于为推论而累积多个连续进展的方法[8、5、9]。
今后的工作应评估入学努力、交易期限和确认业绩之间的取舍。

blocks.en:
Lastly, although the dataset includes four walking speeds per participant, the effect of speed was not specifically evaluated in this work.
All speeds were included in both the development and probe sets, such that most comparisons ( > 75 % >75\% ) were cross-speed.
Thus, some of the observed gains may partially reflect improved robustness to speeds in addition to footwear.
However, gains from the auxiliary datasets were consistent across speeds ( p = 0.70 p=0.70 , Friedman test), while the learning-curve experiments showed either no difference across speeds ( p = 0.09 p=0.09 with single-domain expansion) or greater gains for within-speed comparisons (average 1.5 percentage points higher than cross-speed comparisons with multi-domain expansion; p = 0.0004 p=0.0004 ).
Previous work further suggests that walking speed has a smaller effect on recognition than footwear [ 7 ] .
Nevertheless, explicitly evaluating speed generalization, as well as other deployment-relevant covariates such as load carriage [ 50 ] , remains a direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
最后,虽然数据集包括每个参与者四个行走速度,但在本作中没有具体评价速度的效果.
所有速度都包含在开发与探测器中,因此大多数比较( > 75% > 75\%)都是跨速度.
因此,所观察到的一些增益可能部分反映了鞋类以外速度的提高。
然而,辅助数据集的增益在速度上是一致的(p=0.70 p=0.70,弗里德曼测试),而学习曲线实验显示速度上没有差别(p=0.09 p=0.09,单域扩展),或者速度内比较的增益更大(平均比与多域扩展的跨速比较高1.5个百分点;p=0.0004 p=0.0004)。
前作还进一步表明行走速度对识别的影响比鞋类要小 [7].
尽管如此,明确评价速度的一般化,以及诸如载货运输等其他与部署有关的同变量,仍然是今后工作的方向。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en:
This work investigated whether footwear-robust identity representations can be learned from one population and transferred, zero-shot, to previously unseen users.
We showed that a bi-stream architecture decomposing spatial and temporal gait representations outperforms 3D baselines for cross-footwear recognition, and that performance scales predictably with the volume and diversity of footwear representation in training, with gains transferring to styles not directly observed in the training set.
These findings indicate that footwear-induced shift is heterogeneous across individuals, but contains shared, learnable structure.
Nonetheless, performance remains unsaturated, suggesting that more training data than any single available dataset can provide is likely needed to fully resolve it.
However, we found that auxiliary gait datasets, despite differing sensing modalities and protocols, can be leveraged to improve robustness.
blocks.zh:
这项工作调查了是否可以从一个人群中了解鞋类-活性身份标识,并将零镜头转移给先前未见的用户。
我们显示,双流结构分解了空间和时间步态的表示,超过了跨脚套识别的3D基线,而且根据培训中鞋类代表的数量和多样性可以预测性能的尺度,其中收益转移到培训中未直接观察到的样式。
这些调查结果表明,鞋类引起的转变因个人而异,但包含共同的可学习的结构。
尽管如此,业绩仍然不饱和,这表明可能需要比任何单一现有数据集提供的更多培训数据才能完全解决。
然而,我们发现,尽管有不同的感知方式和协议,仍可以利用辅助速度数据集来提高稳健性。

blocks.en:
The architectural details for the three spatiotemporal baseline models are in Table SI .
Each of these backbones encode a single 3D footstep pressure recording (101 time steps × 75 pixels × 40 pixels) into a 256-dim embedding, and the embeddings from the left and right footsteps in a stride are fused using the fully-connected fusion head described in the main text.

blocks.en: At the time of writing, all auxiliary datasets used in this work are freely accessible to the research community.

blocks.en:
Identical preprocessing was applied to the four force plate datasets to improve consistency during training, following the pipeline used by the GaitRec authors [ 24 ] .
Recordings were cropped in time to the interval where vertical GRF exceeded 80 N, filtered with a 2nd-order low-pass Butterworth filter (20 Hz cutoff), and resampled to 101 time steps using nearest-neighbor interpolation.
For this study, GRF time series were additionally divided by their mean amplitude and COP time series were mean-centered and divided by the total anteroposterior span.
Strides from the ForceID-A, GaitRec, and Gutenberg datasets were labeled as left or right steps by the original authors.
For the Bialystok dataset, we applied the authors’ provided scripts for automated left/right stride detection [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh:
在Gaitrec作者使用管道之后,对四个军号数据集进行了同样的预处理,以提高训练期间的一致性[24]。
记录被及时收割到垂直GRF超过80N的间隔,被过滤出2等低通路Butterworth滤波器(20 Hz截取),并使用相距最近的相邻插值被再被复制到101个时段.
就本研究而言,全球资源论坛的时间序列因平均振幅而被进一步划分,缔约方会议的时间序列以平均为中心,并被整个角跨除去。
来自ForceID-A,GaitRec,和Gutenberg数据集的Strides被原作者标为左取或右取.
对于Bialystok数据集,我们应用了作者提供的脚本进行左/右脚步自动检测[26].

blocks.en:
For the MFID-200 dataset, which consists of a single 2D peak pressure map for each trial (capturing approximately 14 consecutive steps on the sensing platform), individual footsteps were extracted using techniques similar to those used for StepUP-P150 [ 10 ] .
Pressure maps were thresholded to detect areas of activity, processed using morphological dilation and erosion, and a simple connected-components technique was used to detect the bounding box for each footstep.
The footstep images were then roughly aligned by rotating the foot’s long axis (i.e., its first principal component) to the y y -axis, downsampled with linear resizing to match the resolution of StepUP-P150 ( 4 ​ px / cm 2 4~\rm{px}/cm^{2} ), and zero-padded to 75 × 40 pixels.
During training, pressures above the 99th percentile were clipped, and the resulting maps were min-max normalized and rescaled using a natural log transformation.
Footsteps were labeled as left or right based on the proportion of active pixels from different quadrants of the forefoot [ 27 ] , and consecutive steps were grouped into overlapping left/right pairs to form strides for training.
blocks.zh:
对于MFID-200数据集,该数据集由单个2D峰值压力图为每次试验所组成(在感知平台上连续抓取了大约14个步骤),个人脚步被用类似于StepUP-P150[10]的技术提取出.
对压力图进行了阈值,以检测活动区域,采用形态放大和侵蚀处理,并采用了简单的连接组件技术来检测每个步道的边框。
然后将脚步图像大致对齐,将脚的长轴(即它的第一个主构件)旋转到y-轴上,用线性再缩放来做下取样,以匹配StepUP-P150(4 px / cm 2 4~\rm{px}/cm^{2})的分辨率,零加到75×40像素.
在训练期间,九十九分之一以上的压力被剪接出来,产生的地图被分级正常化并使用天然的木质变换进行再分级.
脚步被标记为左出或右出,根据前足不同四象素活像素的比例[27],接连的步被组合成相重叠的左出/右出对来形成出步来进行训练.
